$comment: Turn on only what you can satisfy today. A section left out is a check that does not run, and `harnessimo doctor` reports it as not set rather than implying it is enforced. Adding a check later is a commit; claiming one you do not have is a lie your team will act on.

cleanExit.$comment: Scoped to what a session changed, so adopting this is not blocked by debris that predates the rule. Pick the markers that mean 'unfinished' in your code — console.log is debris in an application and the product in a CLI.

instructions.$comment: A long instruction file buries its important parts in the middle. The limit is what keeps the entry file a router rather than a manual.
